title: Deliver static CSS and server-load generated HTML
decision: Migrated CSS is extracted to static/wix.css and the large generated HTML payload is loaded server-side from file in +page.server.ts before rendering through a dedicated wrapper component.
context: Inlining large style and HTML payloads in client-side route code would increase bundle/runtime overhead and reduce cacheability.
implementation: src/routes/+page.server.ts reads src/lib/content/home.html and returns pageHtml.
consequences: Avoids shipping full migrated HTML string in client bundle.
